-Nutmeg Tiger Cookie:
Nutmeg Tiger Cookie (Korean: 넛맥타이거맛 쿠키, neotmaeg-taigeo-mat kuki).
Nutmeg Tiger Cookie is the ruthless general of the Nutmeg Tiger Tribe of Wild Spices. She is unflinchingly loyal to Burning Spice Cookie, believing that power and greatness can only come from strength such as his.
In the Spice Storm-ridden wastelands, a fierce Cookie commands her troops with an iron fist. She is none other than the legendary general of the Spice Swarm, Nutmeg Tiger Cookie! Half Wild Spice, half Cookie—if the rumors are to be believed—her superior strength has been proven in countless battles. In the past, she rose to power as a great warrior who claimed victory over all the Spice Tribes. Never known weakness, she does not understand the weak. Defeat is an unfamiliar concept to her, for in her world, strength is the only way. It's no wonder she swore allegiance to the mighty Burning Spice Cookie upon his return. But will her loyalty be acknowledged in time? Only fate can tell.

Having grown up in a war-torn wasteland where those with strength can lead their tribes to survive, Nutmeg Tiger Cookie believes that only the strongest deserve to have authority, reflected in the way she and the other Wild Spices serve Burning Spice Cookie without question. But while others serve him out of either fear or opportunity, she serves him out of pure loyalty and admiration, was willing to take back half of her master's Soul Jam from Golden Cheese Cookie, whom she and the other Spices view only as a thief. Nutmeg Tiger Cookie's unwavering convictions had been infamous among the tribes even before Burning Spice Cookie's arrival, however, which allows her to command even the greatest gatherings of Wild Spices with only a word. She believes that all tribes should share in her unquestioning belief in the value of strength, and tolerates not even a single action to the contrary from even the lowliest of Kulfi.
